items.title: Audio editing basics (gain, fades, meters, pitch)
items.evidence: app/test/timeline-audio.test.ts (19 tests, red-first: gain math, setClipAudio/setTrackVolume sparse+clamp+locked+linked, split fade halves, normalize/validate, render arg shape incl. legacy-identical default and asetrate natural pitch), app/test/timeline-preview.test.ts (+2: override gainAt, bedGainAt), editor gesture test (vol line, fade handles, track slider, pitch toggle), ASSEMBLY_E2E ffmpeg 7/7 incl. new audio describe (2s fade-out RMS near silence in rendered file; 2x preserve-pitch measures ~440Hz by zero-crossings and natural ~880Hz; durations match). tsc clean; full suite 2236 passed / 1 pre-existing group failure; build + ui:verify pass (2026-11-02T16-35-39-007Z; Step 4 unreachable in fresh-profile harness, behavior proven by gesture/unit/E2E tests).
items.notes: Meters read post-gain peaks from the already-decoded VO/music buffers (no WebAudio graph inserted into the audible path); embedded clip audio is not metered. Non-role audio-track clips still gather-only in the plan mix until A9 generalizes (pre-existing plan shape); video-embedded audio and role beds carry full gain/fades/pitch now. Track-volume slider UI on audio tracks; model/render also honor video-track volume.

items.title: Cross-dissolve transitions as timeline data
items.evidence: app/test/timeline-transitions.test.ts (16 tests, red-first: handle math incl. sped/reversed/still, refuse past handles, split remap, trim prune, resolver blendSpans, plan merge with extended windows, EDL D), preview blend mapping test, editor dissolve select/clamp/remove test, ASSEMBLY_E2E 9/9 incl. dissolve describe (midpoint frame measures both sources ~50/50, pure outside window, total duration unchanged). tsc clean; full suite 2254 passed / 1 pre-existing group failure (name-verified); build + ui:verify pass (2026-11-02T16-59-51-189Z).
items.notes: Centered convention. Removing a dissolve restores the exact pre-transition timeline (toEqual in tests). Preview blends video<->video truly (stacked elements + opacity); still-involved dissolves preview as a cut at the edit, render exact. Tween-block spans don't merge (stay cuts in render; transition data retained). Ramped incoming blend windows extrapolate boundary speed in the handle region (stated approximation, same class as ramp audio).

Known format risks: timeMap point semantics and fade element shape follow the commonly-generated dialect; asset durations are referenced extents; connected clips nest in the covering spine item with timeline-absolute offsets (OTIO-style). Resolve-specific simplifications cannot be enumerated until an operator import (stated in report boilerplate via asset note).
